general.meritName: ~20% of admits get merit; no tiers published
general.dl: ED1 Nov 1 / RD Jan 4; Rice/Baylor MSP with application
general.note: Elite premed with the Texas Medical Center (the largest medical complex in the world) next door. Rice/Baylor Medical Scholars guarantees a Baylor College of Medicine seat to ~6 students a year — the hardest BS/MD-class door in the country. Need aid is generous below $200k income; above it, full pay.
general.medNote: Reach on admission; MSP is a lottery on top. Full pay at your income unless rare merit lands.
